title: K-flat derived tensor structure on schemes
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $D(\mathcal O_X)$ its derived category [def-pc-derived-category]. Its derived tensor monoidal structure has unit $\mathcal O_X[0]$ and tensor $E\otimes^L F$ computed by the total tensor complex [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves] after a K-flat replacement [def-pc-kflat-complex]. The associators and unitors descend from the tensor of sheaves of modules, with its additive closed structure [lem-pc-sheaf-modules-tensor-closed]. Choose the K-flat derived monoidal construction of the localization of the homotopy category, with these constraints; this specifies the tensor on objects and morphisms, not an arbitrary monoidal structure.
